description: This file parses and processes Khronos registry XML files related to OpenGL and EGL extensions, defining classes and functions to handle extension data, commands, and support classification.

classes.name: GLCommandNames
classes.description: Manages collections of OpenGL command names categorized by version.

classes.name: RegistryXML
classes.description: Handles parsing and manipulation of Khronos registry XML files, including extension and command management.

methods.name: RegistryXML.__init__
methods.description: Initializes the RegistryXML object by parsing the main XML file and optionally appending extension data.

methods.name: RegistryXML._AppendANGLEExts
methods.description: Appends extension commands and extensions from an external extension XML file.

methods.name: RegistryXML.AddCommands
methods.description: Adds commands associated with a specific feature to the registry, avoiding duplicates.

methods.name: RegistryXML._ClassifySupport
methods.description: Classifies support type based on extension attributes.

methods.name: RegistryXML.AddExtensionCommands
methods.description: Processes supported extensions, filtering and adding extension commands, handling duplicates.

methods.name: GLCommandNames.get_commands
methods.description: Retrieves command names for a specific version.

methods.name: GLCommandNames.get_all_commands
methods.description: Returns a combined list of all command names across versions.

methods.name: GLCommandNames.add_commands
methods.description: Adds new commands to a specific version, avoiding duplicates.
